subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Windows Companion default move to `2026.7.2-beta.3` before an official OpenClaw artifact includes and proves the required wizard-runtime correction?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the supported release policy while the supplied evidence says the selected official artifact still fails the native-wizard Gateway path; this is a product support-contract choice rather than a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Keep a setup-proven default
options.body: Retain the current supported default until an official artifact containing the upstream correction completes the real Companion setup and reconnect path.

options.title: Approve beta targeting explicitly
options.body: Accept the prerelease default only with a maintainer-owned support statement and an in-product recovery path for the known wizard failure.

options.title: Split independent fixes
options.body: Land only the culture-formatting and bounded Companion recovery work while pausing the default-version change.

recommendation.title: Keep a setup-proven default
recommendation.body: Retain the current supported default until an official artifact containing the upstream correction completes the real Companion setup and reconnect path.

likelyOwner.reason: CassieMei is the only evidence-backed technical routing candidate in the supplied history for the version target and wizard lifecycle changes.
